# Senior Backend Engineer (Python) at Example Freight

Made-up job description for tests. The company and every detail are fictional.

## About the role
You will design and scale the backend services behind our shipment tracking platform.

## What you will do
- Build REST APIs and microservices in Python with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
- Design event-driven services that consume shipment events from Kafka.
- Run background jobs and task queues (Celery) with Redis.
- Deploy containerized services on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Own observability: structured logging, metrics and tracing for every service.

## Requirements
- 5+ years building backend services in Python.
- Async programming, caching and database query tuning.
- CI/CD and automated testing with pytest.

## Nice to have
- gRPC, idempotent payment or billing APIs.
